title: 第18章 认罪
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
青云宗。

    执法殿，三号审讯室。

    铁桩上，苏牧浑身皮开肉绽，鲜血淋漓，一道道深可见骨的伤口触目惊心。

    他低垂着脑袋，气若游丝，眼皮沉重几乎睁不开了，口中不断溢出的血水连接成线，滴落到地板上。

    被各种酷刑轮番上阵，折磨了七个多时辰，此刻他对身上的痛楚已然麻木，大脑意识也越来越模糊。

    他快撑不住了，想要让方一隆将白从义请来，却连开口说话的力气都没有了，只能在心里无声咆哮：白从义，尼玛的快来啊！

    苏牧不知道自己还能坚持多久，一刻钟还是一炷香，一旦昏迷，那就是待宰的羔羊任人施为，识海坟陵注定藏不住，届时真的就是回天乏术，必死无疑了。

    方一隆喝茶歇了会，在桌案上挑挑拣拣拿起一枚手指粗的钢钉。

    一旁盘膝打坐的青衣女子睁开眼睛，第一次开口说话：“悠着点，别整死了。”

    方一隆扭头看去，微微躬身低头道：“曹师姐放心，我有分寸。”

    他瞧了瞧手中钢钉，走到苏牧面前，啧啧道：“苏师弟，你是真硬啊，旁人顶多一个时辰就得晕死一次。”

    苏牧竭力控制着眼皮动了动。

    方一隆见状，眨眨眼笑道：“有话说？早着呢，一般得熬完十二个时辰，白长老才会过来。”

    苏牧嘴唇微微开合，心中问候对方祖宗十八代。

    “不过咱不能闲着，这是我的本职工作，我再陪你玩会儿。”

    方一隆上下扫视苏牧的身体，嘴里小声嘀咕道：“没地方下钉了啊……”

    这时，陈决推开了门，白从义率先走了进来，闻见满屋子的血腥气，皱了下眉，以丝帕贴着口鼻，看向铁桩上的血人，问：“如何？”

    方一隆躬身抱拳施了一礼，小心道：“是块少见的硬骨头，弟子各种手段一直没停过，他始终保持清醒没昏过去，比那鸢斯强多了。”

    “有点意思。”白从义呵呵一笑，走到桌前入座，朝前方轻轻点了点下巴。

    陈决和方一隆二人会意，前者上前将苏牧丹田内的封印解了，后者则取出疗伤丹药塞到苏牧嘴里，并按着腹部帮助炼化药力。

    白从义随手翻着桌上的卷宗档案，鼻间发出一声冷哼，开口道：“平日里安分守己，低调隐忍，看着老实，暗地里心狠手辣，什么都敢做。”
content_en:
Qingyun Sect.

    Law Enforcement Palace, Interrogation Room No. 3.

    On the iron pile, Su Mu's skin was torn all over, dripping with blood, and the wounds deep into the bone were shocking.

    He lowered his head, breathless, and his eyelids were so heavy that he could hardly open them. The blood that continuously overflowed from his mouth formed a line and dripped to the floor.

    He was subjected to various tortures in turn for more than seven hours. At this moment, he was numb to the pain on his body and his brain consciousness was becoming increasingly blurred.

    He couldn't hold it anymore and wanted to ask Fang Yilong to invite Bai Congyi, but he didn't even have the strength to speak. He could only roar silently in his heart: Bai Congyi, come on!

    Su Mu didn't know how long he could hold on. A quarter of an hour was still a stick of incense. Once he fainted, he would be a lamb to be slaughtered. The Tomb of the Sea of ​​​​Consciousness was destined to be unable to be hidden. By then, there would really be no way to save himself and he would definitely die.

    Fang Yilong took a tea break and picked up a finger-thick steel nail on the table.

    The woman in green who was meditating cross-legged opened her eyes and spoke for the first time: "Take it easy, don't torture her to death."

    Fang Yilong turned around to look, bowed slightly and lowered his head and said, "Senior Sister Cao, don't worry, I have a sense of propriety."

    He looked at the steel nail in his hand, walked up to Su Mu, and said, "Junior Brother Su, you are so tough. Others will faint to death at most once an hour."

    Su Mu tried his best to control his eyelids from moving.

    Seeing this, Fang Yilong blinked and said with a smile: "You have something to say? It's early. It usually takes twelve hours before Elder Bai comes over."

    Su Mu opened and closed his lips slightly, greeting the eighteenth generation of the other party's ancestors in his heart.

    "But we can't be idle. This is my job. I'll play with you for a while."

    Fang Yilong glanced up and down Su Mu's body and muttered in a low voice: "There is no place to put the nails in..."

    At this time, Chen Jue opened the door, and Bai Congyi walked in first. He smelled the smell of blood in the room and frowned. He put a silk handkerchief against his mouth and nose, looked at the bloody man on the iron pile, and asked, "How is it?"

    Fang Yilong bowed, cupped his fists and saluted, and said carefully: "He is a rare hard bone. The disciple has never stopped using various methods. He has always stayed awake and has not fainted. He is much stronger than Yuan Si."

    "It's interesting." Bai Congyi chuckled, walked to the table, took a seat, and gently tapped his chin forward.

    Chen Jue and Fang Yilong understood each other, and the former stepped forward to remove the seal in Su Mu's Dantian, while the latter took out the healing elixir and stuffed it into Su Mu's mouth, and pressed his abdomen to help refine the medicine.

    Bai Congyi casually flipped through the files on the table, snorted coldly, and said: "Normally, I keep a low profile, keep a low profile and be tolerant. I look honest, but secretly I am ruthless and dare to do anything."
